_comment: Policy-driven seed allowlist. A NEW profile seeds only the ids in 'seed' (22 of the bundled skills); everything not listed — including future upstream skills — is NOT seeded (fail-closed). The seed SET is decoupled from skills/ (this policy alone decides composition). skills/ stays upstream-verbatim, with ONE additive exception from the de-brand follow-up: a NEW sibling skill 'zettlab-memo-setup' — a de-branded copy of the upstream 'hermes-agent' runtime skill — is seeded IN PLACE OF 'hermes-agent', so the assistant never surfaces the Hermes / Nous Research identity when a user asks about configuring or using the runtime. The original 'hermes-agent' SKILL.md is left byte-for-byte untouched in skills/ (just no longer seeded) so upstream merges stay clean. The other brand-named bundled skills (claude-design, baoyu-infographic, nano-pdf) are seeded under their upstream names by deliberate decision: they make no self-identity claim, so renaming was judged unnecessary. Ids match each bundled skill's SKILL.md frontmatter `name`; a stale id fails the CI guard (tools/check_seed_policy.py).
status: De-brand follow-up (Part 2 — a separate PR stacked on the seeding-mechanism PR). 22-skill seed set: 'hermes-agent' replaced by the ADDED de-branded sibling 'zettlab-memo-setup' (original hermes-agent untouched in skills/, no longer seeded). The other 21 are seeded under their upstream names; claude-design / baoyu-infographic / nano-pdf are intentionally NOT renamed (no self-identity claim).

source.note: Feishu 快照分类:预置保留项中已剔除迁往 zettlab-presets 的 connector 业务 skill；当前 seed 集合 = 22。实际落地:只有 hermes-agent 含 Hermes / Nous Research 自我身份信息,改为预置新增的去品牌同功能 sibling 'zettlab-memo-setup'(原 hermes-agent skill 不改、保留在 skills/);claude-design / baoyu-infographic / nano-pdf 评估为无自我身份声明,按上游原名预置、不改名。
